race.comment: NO NO NO NO NO (1) started at $1.65 and broke his maiden last start over a similar journey to this at Ipswich although he didn't get it all his own way. Still a work in progress and the winkers going on today may elicit further improvement. G'DAY AUSBRED (5) also won for the first time last start, coming off a seven-week let-up with a massive victory over this distance at Coffs Harbour. Took a long while to hit his straps and that recent let-up obviously did the trick. Can go on with it now. NOMOMEIKUSHI (3) is banging on the door after leading for the judge at her last two appearances only to be gunned down late. Should be prominent for a long way again. NO WOMAN NO CRY (2) is back after a 15-week spell. Needs more ground than this but while fresh is a sneaky top four chance. NUTCRACKER QUEEN (7) has not appeared since winning on debut over this course and distance on 7 September. Promising mare who is likely to have progressed over the break.
